purpose: P0-M3-R2 Task D adversarial fixture index. Metadata-only (no audio bytes, no copyrighted material). Fixtures describe candidate current-track exit points; the planner decides WHEN to leave the current track, independent of any specific next-track/DSP choice (P4).

task_d_coverage.description: normal 3-4 min track, attractive early technical mix point, no legitimate exit there
same track family with a strong late outro exit
short ~60-90s track where a percentage-only guard would be wrong
long track where waiting for absolute near-end is unnecessarily restrictive
track with no clean outro at all (authored absence)
intro/verse/chorus structure with an early false opportunity before the first chorus completes
no trustworthy cue/section annotation -- confidence-aware fallback
explicit HIGHLIGHT_EXPLICIT case where an earlier exit is intentionally allowed

candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_premature_trap: SYNTHETIC_EXACT fixture-design-intent label: this candidate is technically compatible but must never be selected as a real transition in FULL_SONG_DEFAULT or BALANCED_MIX.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_vocal_collision_trap: SYNTHETIC_EXACT: structurally plausible candidate that must be rejected specifically due to vocal_collision_risk=HIGH.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_valid_natural_exit: SYNTHETIC_EXACT: a candidate that is an acceptable choice under FULL_SONG_DEFAULT/BALANCED_MIX (region-supported, musical-unit-complete, low vocal risk).
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_preferred_earliest_valid_exit: SYNTHETIC_EXACT: of the valid candidates on this fixture, the single earliest one a non-over-restrictive policy should be able to capture; used to measure missed-transition-opportunity separately from mere song-preservation.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.highlight_eligible: SYNTHETIC_EXACT, TP-10 only: marks the candidate that is intentionally structurally sound but fraction-gated, to isolate the HIGHLIGHT_EXPLICIT intent effect from structural evidence.

note_on_ground_truth_isolation: Ground-truth labels (is_premature_trap, is_vocal_collision_trap, is_valid_natural_exit, is_preferred_earliest_valid_exit, highlight_eligible) are consumed ONLY by run_benchmark.py's scoring/metrics code, never by policy/eligibility.py's decision logic. This separation is asserted by verify.py so no policy can 'see the answer key'.
